name: Pattern & Anomaly Detection in Influence Campaigns (MIT MEng Thesis)
description: My MIT MEng thesis (EECS), built with MIT Lincoln Laboratory's Global Influence Model. I applied statistical and ML methods — Singular Spectrum Analysis, an autoencoder, and an LSTM — to ~30,000 news articles to surface patterns and anomalies in influence campaigns.

name: LLM-Assisted Vulnerability Research on an IP Camera (Georgia Tech Capstone)
description: My Georgia Tech MS Cybersecurity capstone. I benchmarked leading LLMs (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) against static-analysis tools at finding vulnerabilities in an IP camera's code, then generated proof-of-concept payloads. The LLMs found more distinct bugs at a comparable false-positive rate, but struggled with consistency and context.

name: IMC Prosperity 4
description: My run at IMC Trading's global algorithmic trading competition — round-by-round market-making and trading strategies for a simulated exchange.

name: Strategy Evaluation: Manual Rules vs. Q-Learning (ML4T)
description: A Georgia Tech ML4T (CS 7646) final project comparing a hand-built indicator rule set (Bollinger %B, RSI, MACD) against a Q-learning agent on JPM. The RL agent dominates in-sample but fails to generalize — a clean bias–variance illustration. Full report shared on request (kept off the public site per GT's academic-integrity policy).

name: Poker Bot
description: A Texas Hold'em bot that estimates hand equity with Monte Carlo simulation to drive its betting decisions.

name: Blackjack Simulator
description: Simulates card counting over many blackjack trials to quantify how the running count shifts expected value.

name: Perudo Bot
description: Play the dice game Perudo against a bot that runs Bayesian updates on the hidden dice each round. Can you beat it?

name: Fantasy Optimizer
description: A streamer-pick optimizer for ESPN fantasy basketball — daily add/drops to maximize roster output under league constraints.

name: Fill in the Missing Word
description: An MIT 6.863J Natural Language Processing final project: a model that predicts a missing word from the surrounding sentence context.

name: Principles of Autonomy & Decision Making
description: An MIT 6.4132 final project: integrated planning and decision-making for an autonomous agent.

name: 82-0 Solver
description: Automated solvers for the viral 82-0.com roster game — one guarantees a perfect season by controlling the game's randomness, the other grinds it out through fast retries. Includes the reverse-engineering behind them.

name: Escape Transylvania
description: A browser point-and-click escape room set in Castle Dracula — explore rooms, collect objects, and solve puzzles to escape before dawn.

name: Yung Hung Jung: Rent's Due
description: A browser puzzle-platformer: hustle through 10 levels and dodge the landlord's collectors to make rent.

name: Alexa's Bed Bug Battle
description: A 2D puzzle platformer across 10 levels in a single self-contained HTML file, with procedurally generated music and sound effects.
